Subject: Mutual Onboarding Plan — Week 0 standup & owners confirmation

Hi Olivia + team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited to get Ledger Labs into a short evaluation and a tight MAP so we can validate latency/throughput and finalize purchasing. Attached is a first-pass MAP workbook (sheet-per-track). High-level proposal:

- Cadence: 30-min weekly standups for the first 6 weeks (Tuesdays 10:00am PT).
- Owners: we propose the owners column filled in column D in the attached; please confirm or suggest alternates.
- Success criteria (evaluation track): 95th pctl < 250ms for 512-token requests, embedding similarity >= 0.88 on your internal benchmark set, and no more than 1% request error rate during steady-state runs.
- Milestones: Week 1 (data prep & connectivity), Week 2 (baseline tests), Weeks 3–4 (load/latency tuning), Week 5 (pilot pass), Week 6 (purchase decision).

As requested, I attached a signed NDA (pdf) and the MAP workbook. Please: 1) confirm the Tuesday slot or propose another recurring time; 2) confirm attendees from Ledger Labs; 3) indicate who owns the procurement/PO path so we can coordinate pricing and contract redlines.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock recurrence.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Connectivity & Onboarding (internal): Diego Fernandez — set up VPC peering / test keys, validate IAM roles.
- Eval harness & metrics: Rishi Malhotra — provide baseline scripts, run initial runs, and report token-level cost.
- Data ingestion & privacy checks: Priya Natarajan — validate PII filters and retention settings.
- Customer success / cadence: Marissa Cole — weekly sync, success criteria sign-off, escalation / pricing.

Action items for Week 0 (owners):
1) Diego — provide network test checklist + temporary test keys by Fri 5/29.
2) Rishi — share eval harness repo and baseline run instructions by Mon 5/31.
3) Priya — complete quick privacy review (checklist in MAP) and flag any concerns by Mon 5/31.
4) Marissa — send updated invite for Tuesdays 11:00am PT and include meeting notes template.

Notes: I recommend we run a small smoke test (50 concurrent short requests) in Week 1 to validate KV cache behavior before full baseline. If Ledger Labs agrees, we'll include that in the Week 2 baseline schedule.
